annotations.title: Japan customs duty-free allowance on arrival: within/over, duty estimate in yen, cash declaration

description: Japan Customs per-person duty-free allowance when entering Japan (as of 2026-10-14): alcohol 3 bottles of about 760 ml (2.28 L); cigarettes 200 OR cigars 50 OR heat-not-burn 10 packages (200 IQOS/glo sticks, 50 Ploom TECH capsules) OR other tobacco 250 g, more than one kind 250 g total; perfume 2 oz (about 56 ml); other goods ¥200,000 total overseas value, an item kind worth ¥10,000 or less in total is free and not counted, an article over ¥200,000 is fully dutiable. Under 20: no alcohol/tobacco allowance; under 6: only items for the child. Excess duty at the simplified rates: whisky/brandy ¥800/L, rum/gin/vodka ¥500/L, liqueur ¥400/L, distilled ¥300/L, wine/beer ¥200/L, cigarettes and sticks ¥15 each, capsules ¥50, other goods 15% of Customs value (price × 0.6), watches/golf clubs/PCs 10% consumption tax; not applied to articles with Customs value over ¥100,000, cigars or other tobacco. Cash and other means of payment over ¥1,000,000 (¥100,000 bound for North Korea) must be declared. Returns per-category within/over, excess, estimatedSimplifiedDutyJPY (+ High for the strict mixed-tobacco reading), tax-type breakdown truncated to ¥100 (reproduces Customs' ¥19,400 worked example), red/green channel, cashDeclarationRequired, warnings, assumptions, sources, rulesAsOf. Many guides still show pre-2021 tobacco limits — call this instead of guessing. Educational estimate; the Customs officer decides.

ageYears.description: Traveler age. Under 20 = no alcohol/tobacco allowance; under 6 = only items for the child. Default adult.

alcohol.description: Several drinks: [{type, ml or bottles}]. Allowance goes to the highest-rate drink first.

alcoholBottles.description: Bottles of alcohol (assumed 760 ml each unless alcoholMl is given).

alcoholMl.description: Total alcohol volume in ml (allowance 2,280 ml per adult).

alcoholType.description: Drink type for the simplified rate. Default other (¥200/L).

boundForNorthKorea.description: Leaving Japan for North Korea (declaration threshold ¥100,000).

cashJPY.description: Cash (yen + foreign in yen) one person carries.

goldBullionKg.description: Gold bullion carried in kg (over 1 kg must be declared).

goods.description: Other articles: overseas retail price of ONE article in yen, quantity, dutyFreeTariff true for watches / golf clubs / PCs, forChild for a child's items.

goodsTotalJPY.description: Instead of goods: total overseas value of other articles (approximate).

hnbPackages.description: Heat-not-burn packs (allowance 10; 20 sticks or 5 capsules each).

otherTobaccoGrams.description: Pipe / other tobacco in grams (allowance 250 g).

paymentInstrumentsJPY.description: Checks, travelers checks, promissory notes, securities in yen.

perfumeMl.description: Perfume in ml (allowance about 56 ml; eau de toilette not counted).

travelers.description: People in the same age band pooling allowances. Default 1.
